microscopic_method.exchange_correlation_or_many_body_method: PBE normal-state DFT; Eliashberg-combined SCDFT electron-phonon functional; RPA plasmon-assisted kernel and mass renormalization; adiabatic-local-density-approximation spin-fluctuation kernel
microscopic_method.applicability_note: Source describes conventional elemental, A15 and high-pressure hydride systems within SCDFT; this model is not automatically applicable to strongly correlated unconventional systems or experimentally identified PDW phases.
